scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'));if(pkg.version!==manifest.version){console.error('manifest.json version ('+manifest.version+') does not match package.json ('+pkg.version+')');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:main-world && tsc && vite build
